character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: My engine log. I left it in the galley with my coffee. Read me the last entry, would you? I cannot leave the engine.

character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: Something in the port wing. Several. Moving forward. I can hear them on the spar.

character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: The engine is singing again. I cannot shut it off. I have tried.

character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: Engine room here. Riedl. Who is that on the line? Report, please.

character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: This is a test flight. Only a test flight. The crew is to report to their stations.

character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: Haas? Pohl? The kettle is still warm. Where have you gone?

character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: Crew: provided. Provided by whom. Thank you. I will listen to the wing for you.

character: Bordmechaniker Anselm Riedl on the engine-room intercom before he is the Bordwart (40s
text: Is someone hurt back there? Report!
